contribution.received: Natanggap ang mungkahi: {{status}}. Itago ang resibo code para masubaybayan ito.
contribution.offlineDraft: Hindi makakonekta sa server. Nasa page na ito pa rin ang iyong nilalaman.
contribution.lookupFailed: Hindi matingnan ang status sa ngayon.
contribution.sourceAdded: Naidagdag na ang source. Naghihintay ng pagsusuri ang mungkahi.
contribution.ideaIntro: Ilarawan ang totoong problema at ang tool na gusto mo. Sinusuri muna ang mga ideya bago ilathala.
contribution.regulationIntro: Ilarawan ang dapat ayusin at ilagay ang link ng source. Puna ito para suriin ng mga tagapamahala; hindi pa nito binabago ang data ng tool.
contribution.ideaDetail: Ang problema at ang iminumungkahi mong solusyon
contribution.sourceType: Uri ng source na iminumungkahi mo
contribution.consent: Inalis ko na ang personal na impormasyon at mga lihim na key, at pumapayag akong ipadala ang nilalamang ito para suriin ng mga operator
contribution.needsSource: Maglagay ng HTTPS URL sa kahon ng source sa itaas, saka ito idagdag gamit ang resibo code na ito.
contribution.sourceUrlInvalid: The source URL isn't valid. Paste the full address starting with https://
contribution.sourceUrlNotHttps: The source URL must start with https://
contribution.sourceUrlUnsafe: The source URL must be a public page: no IP address, localhost or internal network, no #… part, user name, password or token/key parameter, email or phone number.

sensitive.email: The text contains an email address.
sensitive.phone: The text contains a phone number.
sensitive.secret: The text seems to contain a password, token or API key.
sensitive.internalUrl: The text contains an internal link (localhost, private network IP).

contribution.sensitiveFix: Remove it before sending — the server doesn't accept personal or secret information.

ideas.empty: Wala pang ideyang naaprubahan at nailathala.
ideas.failed: Could not load ideas. Please try again.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Report a problem, suggest an improvement or flag incorrect data in Chuyện Nhỏ. Track our response with your receipt code.
feedback.category: What would you like to share?
feedback.subject: What went wrong or could be improved?
feedback.detail: Describe how it happened and the result you expected
feedback.ideaProblem: What would you like to get done?
feedback.ideaExample: A real example and the result you would like
feedback.privacy: Only the text you enter is sent. Your tool files and results are never attached.
feedback.dataHint: An official source helps us check the data. Feedback is reviewed first and does not change tool data immediately.
feedback.sendFailed: Could not send yet. Your text is still here; check your connection and try again.
feedback.duplicate: This content has already been received. Use your saved receipt code or check My contributions if you were signed in.
feedback.rateLimited: You have sent several contributions this hour. Keep your text and try again later.
feedback.addEvidenceHint: Add a source to the receipt currently being checked. Existing sources are kept.
feedback.searchSuggestion: Missing a tool you need? Suggest it to us
feedback.existingTool: Want to give feedback on an existing tool?
feedback.needTool: Need a new tool? Send a suggestion
feedback.toolHint: New tool ideas are reviewed like Suggest a tool; an approved idea may be shown publicly, without your name.
feedback.dedupedNote: The same feedback was handled before. We kept yours and linked it to that report, so we know the problem came back.
